## About
Bargain Auto & Truck Repairs is a family and locally owned shop on Main Street in South Bound Brook. We're a licensed repair, lube and tune center with ASE Certified mechanics, and we work on cars and trucks, foreign and domestic.
We keep things honest and clear. Estimates are free, we do same day service when you need a quick fix, and we're always glad to answer your questions about what's going on with your car.
Neighbors seem to agree. The shop holds a 4.8 rating from 140 Google reviews, and one longtime customer wrote that Tariq and his crew are the best in business.

## Services
- Diagnostics: Warning light on and not sure what it means? We pinpoint what's wrong with your car or truck so it can be fixed right.
- Brake, electrical and transmission problems: We track down brake system, electrical and transmission issues before small problems turn costly.
- Oil changes and maintenance: Routine oil changes and maintenance to keep your vehicle running smoothly.
- Tune ups and general repairs: Routine tune ups and everyday repairs to keep you on the road.

## FAQ
Q: Can you get my car done the same day?
A: We do same day service for folks who need a quick fix. Give us a call and we'll let you know what we can do.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We repair both foreign and domestic vehicles, cars and trucks alike.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: You're welcome to stop by, but calling ahead to schedule is the best way to get in.
